repos_data.description: The open-source MCP server behind ByteAsk Embedded Docs: a source-grounded, page-cited evidence-retrieval server for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) that write firmware / driver / protocol code and need exact facts.
Zero-config MCP server for searchable documentation (SQLite default, PostgreSQL optional)
Local MCP server that extracts high-level Git repository context for AI coding agents
Open-source MCP server for AI agents: web search, content extraction, and library docs -- 5-strategy scraping, runs without API keys.
MCP server for markdown — search, extract sections, list headings, find code blocks
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for @imqueue — lets AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor and others) search the docs, scaffold typed services & clients and use @imqueue/cli live.

MCP server for AI agents to lookup function signatures from any API. Uses SQLite and universal ctags to index source    files across multiple languages (Python, C, Go, C++, JS, Rust, Java, etc.). Prevents hallucination on unknown or    recently updated source files by providing accurate function signatures
Breaking-change diffs for npm packages, served over REST and MCP, so coding agents stop writing code against outdated API knowledge.
Local cognitive infrastructure for AI coding agents — semantic memory, repository intelligence, and MCP tools to reduce token usage.
A MCP server for using Semgrep to scan code for security vulnerabilities.
Read-only MCP server for the AI Loop Library: pick bounded, verifiable agent work loops and render runnable protocols. Single file, stdlib-only.

repo_meta_data.description: Read-only MCP server for official Python docs: local index, no API keys, exact symbol lookup, version-aware retrieval.
